You identified PX_ECM among the seven edits, read the severity beside every code and established that no event had to be resolved before it, then took the COB amount columns one at a time: Allowed, Copay and Paid each added up to their claim-level totals, and the Discount column showed a total of 164.63 against three line values of 0.00, which no addition can produce. You read the per-line discounts off the claim form — 85.30 + 51.95 + 27.38 = 164.63 — entered them, validated the balance and paid the claim.
